layers.title: Policy Tool PC6 Energy
layers.description: Legacy policy-tool annual gas, electricity consumption, and electricity production by PC6.

data_quality.evidence_summary: Combines real/open annual energy and building data with standard load profiles, enrichment, estimates, and assumptions.

layers.title: PV Capacity
layers.description: Model-estimated installed PV capacity per CBS buurt in gemeente Alkmaar.

layers.title: Electricity Grid Lines
layers.description: Registered and explicitly inferred Liander cable components from the grid topology model.

scale.1: limited supporting data or ambiguous topology
scale.2: registered evidence with documented topology assumptions

layers.title: Electricity Grid Transformers
layers.description: Liander LV/MV transformers and modelled MV/HV source endpoints from the grid topology model.

scale.1: limited supporting data or ambiguous topology
scale.2: registered evidence with documented topology assumptions

layers.title: LV/MV Transformer Reach by PC6 Share
layers.description: Original PC6 polygons with direct absolute shares assigned to electrically connected LV/MV transformers.

scale.1: limited supporting data or ambiguous topology
scale.2: registered evidence with documented topology assumptions

limitations: Only PC6 polygons supplied to the grid initializer are represented.
Shares use intersecting LV cable length; PC6 areas without an intersection use an explicitly marked nearest-LV-bus fallback.
Assignments are model-estimated and are not legal or authoritative service territories.

layers.title: MV/HV Transformer Reach by PC6 Share
layers.description: Original PC6 polygons with direct absolute shares aggregated by their electrically connected MV/HV transformer roots.

scale.1: limited supporting data or ambiguous topology
scale.2: registered evidence with documented topology assumptions

limitations: Only PC6 polygons supplied to the grid initializer are represented.
Shares use intersecting LV cable length; PC6 areas without an intersection use an explicitly marked nearest-LV-bus fallback.
Assignments are model-estimated and are not legal or authoritative service territories.

layers.title: Public Wind Turbines
layers.description: Exact-position public wind turbines in Alkmaar with published nameplate data and provisional 2025 generation summaries.

scale.2: published inventory with documented modeling assumptions
scale.3: complete published inventory without modeled assumptions

layers.title: Reported Neighbourhood Heat Consumers
layers.description: Neighbourhood polygons with registered rounded district-heating shares and model-estimated connected dwellings and heat demand.

layers.title: Inferred PC6 Heat Consumers
layers.description: PC6 polygons with model allocations, candidate signals, exclusions, and explicit Liander corroboration or conflict labels.

layers.title: Registered Heat Network Developments
layers.description: Registered development-plan polygons; registration does not establish an operating connection.

layers.title: Documented Actual Heat Sources
layers.description: Documented operating heat-production sites, kept separate from potential source candidates.

layers.title: Documented Large Heat Consumers
layers.description: Documented examples of large connected consumers without unsupported private consumption values.

layers.title: Potential Heat Sources
layers.description: Registered potential heat-source candidates; candidate status is not evidence of an operating connection.

layers.title: Public EV Charging Locations
layers.description: Individual public charging locations in the frozen Alkmaar NDW/DOT-NL inventory with deterministic modelled profile summaries.

data_quality.limitations: Locations and connector inventory are source-backed; charging demand profiles are modelled rather than measured.
